card.name: Commas and linking words in religious text
card.fires_on: Small connecting words and commas partway through a sentence, mostly in religious or moral-teaching prose (Talmud, Bible, rabbi stories). It also fires once in a drug-label sentence about bleeding.

modes.label: Religious teaching prose
modes.description: Comma, 'to', 'him' or 'said' in sentences about sin, scripture or a rabbi's teaching.

modes.label: Label sentence on bleeding
modes.description: Comma or 'the' after a clause about bleeding resembling menstruation, before advice to the patient.

card.writes: It pushes toward religious vocabulary such as Christian, Jesus, Gospel, Torah and Buddhism.
